newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers slightly softer, quiet.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers slightly softer, quiet.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were slightly softer on Monday on modest demand of 15,000 tonnes, brokers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunker fuel was at $87/89 a tonne against $89/91 on Friday, with 180 cst steady at $94/96.
"Demand is quite low but supply is sufficient," one broker said.

Antwerp bunkers were at similar levels, with diesel at $157/162 and gas oil at $169/173, about $1 higher than in Rotterdam. "Demand was very poor this morning but it was reasonable in the afternoon," another broker said.
High sulphur barge prices continued the slide begun on Friday, falling to $86.50 in Rotterdam, on low demand and plenty of oil, traders said.
Demand in Fos was brisk, with 380 cst rising to $90 from $84 and 180 cst at $96 from $89, but Augusta and Piraeus were quiet.
